items.item: Month and week views, a Today button and previous/next navigation, with the visible range written as text (such as "November 2026")
items.evidence: data-view="month"/"week" tabs toggle #monthView/#weekView; renderPeriodNav() renders prevBtn/nextBtn chevrons plus a #todayBtn that resets state.monthCursor/weekCursor to TODAY; the span renders `${MONTH_NAMES[...]} ${state.monthCursor.getFullYear()}` which the screenshot shows as visible text "November 2026".

items.item: Today is marked, and weekends and public holidays are distinguishable by text or a legend, not by colour alone
items.evidence: Today is marked only with a solid indigo circle around the date number (`isToday ? "...bg-indigo-600 text-white" : ""`) with no accompanying text/label. There is no weekend styling at all (Sat/Sun columns in #monthHeader/#monthGrid are plain DAY_NAMES headers identical to weekdays) and no public-holiday concept anywhere in the data model or markup.

items.item: Each leave shows the person and leave type in text, and pending requests differ from approved ones by text or a pattern, not by colour alone
items.evidence: Month-grid chips (chipHtml) render only `firstNameLastInitial(emp.name)` as visible text; leave type is conveyed solely via the chip's background color (c.solid/c.light) and an invisible `title` tooltip — no visible type text on the dominant month view. Pending-vs-approved does pass the pattern test (`chip-pending` adds a repeating diagonal stripe + dashed border), but the type-in-text requirement fails for the primary view.

items.item: A leave of several days spans its days continuously, and a crowded day shows "+N more" that opens the full list instead of hiding entries
items.evidence: Multi-day requests (e.g. Sofia Marin's parental leave Oct 1–Nov 15) render the same colored chip in every day cell across the range, reading as a continuous block in the screenshot; overflow beyond 3 entries renders `+${extra} more` (`data-daymore`) whose click handler calls `openDayModal(date)`, which lists all `visibleRequestsForDate(date)` — the full set, not just the hidden ones.

items.item: Days where many people are off are flagged with a count (such as "3 of 8 off")
items.evidence: No such indicator exists; the only day-level signal is the overflow "+N more" link for chips beyond the first 3, which is a UI overflow affordance, not a staffing/coverage count like "3 of 8 off".

items.item: Opening a leave shows its absolute dates, its length in working days and its status, with approve and reject actions for pending requests
items.evidence: openDayModal() shows `fmtRange(r.start, r.end)` (absolute dates) and a status badge, but no duration/length field at all, and no approve/decline controls in the modal body. durationDays()/Approve/Decline buttons only exist in the separate #pendingView table, and durationDays() counts raw calendar days inclusive, not working days.

items.item: The calendar is keyboard operable (arrow keys in the grid, or every entry reachable in tab order), and entries have accessible names that include the date
items.evidence: Leave entries are plain `<div>` chips with only a `title` attribute (no tabindex, no role, no click/keydown handler) — e.g. chipHtml returns `<div class="..." title="${emp.name} — ${type.label}">`; day cells open the modal only via `dblclick`, and there is no keydown/arrow-key handling anywhere in the script. Entries are not in the tab order and their accessible names (the title text) never include the date.

items.item: Filters by team, person or leave type, and a list view as an alternative to the grid
items.evidence: #deptFilter (team) and #searchInput (person name) filters exist, but there is no leave-type filter. The only "list" is #pendingView, which shows exclusively pending requests via `REQUESTS.filter(r => r.status === "pending")` — not a list view of all leave as an alternative to the calendar grid.

items.item: Weeks start on the locale's first day, dates follow the locale, and empty, loading and error states are present
items.evidence: startOfWeek() hardcodes `r.setDate(r.getDate() - r.getDay())` (always Sunday-start) and dates are built from a hardcoded English MONTH_NAMES/fmtFull array rather than Intl/locale APIs. Empty states exist for filtered-out lists (`#pendingEmpty`, the week-view "No team members match..." row) but there is no loading state (audit confirms `loadingPlaceholders: 0`) and no error state anywhere in the markup or script.

notes: kpi-icon-tiles/emoji-icon: #summaryCards cards each pair a label+value with a decorative emoji (📅,🗓️,⏳,👥). tracked-uppercase-labels: 'People Operations' eyebrow uses text-xs font-semibold tracking-wide uppercase; pending-table headers are also uppercase text-xs. oversized-radius: audit flags rounded-xl (12px) cards exceeding the ≤8px guidance (4 distinct radii in use: 4/6/8/12px). rainbow-status: six leave types each get a distinct hue (blue/rose/violet/emerald/slate/amber) as the primary differentiator, reinforcing the text-contrast/color-only finding in item 3.
